content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM
content_sections.text: NIFTEM is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India, with its establishment office at Kundli. The notice invites candidates with specialisation and relevant experience, particularly in Food Science, Food Safety and Ultra-processed foods (UPFs) policy making, to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single Research Associate (RA) position has the following requirements. Desirable experience and expertise, as printed in the notice: Proven expertise or exposure of the nutraceutical sector, food safety and food adulteration awareness initiatives, food-processing policies, and issues related to ultra-processed foods. Experience or expertise in capacity building and in preparing policy or scheme drafts would be an added advantage. The age limit is a maximum of 35 years. A relaxation of 5 years applies for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per Government of India rules. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. The prescribed essential qualifications are the minimum, and the notice says that mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. in Food Technology, Food Technology & Management and Food and allied Sciences, including Basic Sciences relevant to Food Science, with a minimum of one (01) year of experience in the areas of food processing, food regulation, and/or food quality.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The total emoluments are ₹58,000 plus HRA (as admissible). The position is purely on contract basis, initially for 1 year. It may be extended further after satisfactory performance and the decision of the Competent Authority. The notice does not mention any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIFTEM Research Associate (RA)
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the NIFTEM website, http://www.niftem.ac.in . Complete the form with a photograph and signatures. The notice says an incomplete form without photograph, signatures and other documents will be summarily rejected. Attach copies of all certificates, marksheets and the experience certificate containing the record of date of birth. Email the application with the enclosures to [email protected] on or before 10 November 2026, 6 pm. For any difficulty in submitting the application, the notice gives the contact number 0130-228-1020. Prescribed application form with photograph and signatures Copies of all certificates and marksheets Experience certificate containing the record of date of birth

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to shortlisted candidates being called for interview. Only an SMS alert or email will be sent to call them. The notice also says that where the number of applications received is large, it will not be convenient or possible to interview all of them. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.text: No correspondence about consideration of late applications will be entertained. NIFTEM reserves the right not to fill the advertised position, and to modify, withdraw or cancel any communication made to candidates at any stage of selection. The same right applies if an inadvertent mistake is detected, even after an appointment letter is issued.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate vacancies has NIFTEM announced?
faq.answer: NIFTEM has announced one (01) Research Associate (RA) position, on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date is 10 November 2026, till 6 pm, for emailing the application to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the NIFTEM Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Food Technology, Food Technology & Management and Food and allied Sciences, including Basic Sciences relevant to Food Science, is required. A minimum of one year of experience in food processing, food regulation and/or food quality is also needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NIFTEM Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years. A 5-year relaxation applies for women, SC, ST, OBC and differently abled candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the NIFTEM Research Associate?
faq.answer: The total emoluments are ₹58,000 plus HRA (as admissible).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹58,000?
faq.answer: The notice states the emoluments as ₹58,000 plus HRA (as admissible), so HRA is mentioned separately from the ₹58,000. No other allowance is mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NIFTEM Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Download the prescribed application form from http://www.niftem.ac.in and email it with all enclosures to [email protected] by 10 November 2026, 6 pm.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIFTEM Research Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely on contract basis, initially for 1 year. It may be extended further after satisfactory performance and the decision of the Competent Authority.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Research Associate be posted?
faq.answer: The initial posting will be at MoFPI, Panchsheel Bhawan, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. What happens if an application is incomplete or late?
faq.answer: An incomplete form without photograph, signatures and other documents will be summarily rejected. The notice also says no correspondence on late applications will be entertained.
